products.title: Hand-Carved Oak Serving Board
products.description: A generously sized serving board carved from sustainably sourced oak — perfect for entertaining or everyday kitchen rituals.
products.story: Born from evenings around a Bhopal family table, where sharing food meant sharing time.
products.whyMade: We wanted a board that felt like an heirloom from the first use — something that gathers people, not just appetizers. In Bhopal homes, meals stretch long; this piece was made to hold that rhythm.
products.howMade: Each board is hand-carved from sustainably sourced oak in a small Madhya Pradesh workshop, sanded through fine grits, then finished with food-safe oil so the grain deepens with every gathering.

reviews.comment: Beautiful grain and substantial feel — our go-to cheese board.

products.title: Linen Wall Macrame Tapestry
products.description: An airy large-scale macrame piece woven from soft natural cord — softens blank walls with texture and light.
products.story: Knot by knot, a quiet meditation that turns empty walls into something living.
products.whyMade: Blank apartment walls in new Bhopal homes felt cold. This tapestry was designed to bring soft shadow and handmade presence into rooms that still smelled of fresh paint.
products.howMade: Knotted over three days from natural linen cord, finished with a hand-sanded birch dowel. Every pattern is counted by hand — no two hang exactly alike.

products.title: Speckled Stoneware Vase Set
products.description: A trio of wheel-thrown vases with a soft speckled glaze — lovely alone or clustered on a console.
products.story: Thrown for monsoon flowers and everyday stems from the neighbourhood market.
products.whyMade: We noticed homes filled with plastic bottles used as vases. This set was made so everyday flowers — marigold, jasmine, market greens — could sit in something worthy of them.
products.howMade: Thrown on a kick wheel in a Bhopal studio, bisque-fired, then glazed with a signature ash blend and high-fired for durability. Speckles come from the clay itself, not a stencil.

products.title: Abstract Botanical Print
products.description: Limited-edition print with soft greens and warm neutrals that complement handmade textiles and wood.
products.story: Drawn from walks along the Upper Lake — leaves, light, and quiet water.
products.whyMade: We wanted art that feels rooted in Central India without being literal — a soft reminder of Bhopal's green belts and lakeside mornings for walls far from home.
products.howMade: Illustrated by hand, then printed as a signed, numbered edition on archival cotton rag with pigment inks. Each print is inspected for colour fidelity before it leaves the studio.

products.title: Beeswax Pillar Candle Trio
products.description: Slow-burning beeswax pillars with a gentle honey scent — warm ambient light for evenings at home.
products.story: Made for power-cut evenings and slow dinners when the lights go soft.
products.whyMade: During summer outages, candlelight is not aesthetic — it is life. We wanted pillars that burn clean, smell of honey, and feel honest in Indian homes.
products.howMade: Hand-poured in small batches from pure beeswax with cotton wicks, then cooled overnight so the burn stays even. Ceramic cups are meant to be reused as tiny planters.

products.title: Terracotta Hanging Planter
products.description: Hand-formed terracotta planter with a braided jute hanger — ideal for trailing greens and herbs.
products.story: Clay from local earth, fired so every piece carries a faint flame kiss.
products.whyMade: Balconies in Indian cities are often the only garden. This planter was made to hang greens and tulsi where floor space is scarce — and to look beautiful empty or full.
products.howMade: Hand-formed from terracotta clay, fired in a wood kiln that leaves subtle flame marks, then paired with a braided jute hanger finished by hand.

products.title: Handwoven Linen Tea Towels
products.description: A set of three tea towels woven on a traditional loom — soft, absorbent, and beautiful on display.
products.story: Loom-woven for kitchens where chai spills and hospitality never ends.
products.whyMade: Disposable kitchen cloths felt wasteful. These towels were made to soften with use, hang with dignity, and last through years of everyday Indian cooking.
products.howMade: Woven on a traditional loom from flax linen in patterns passed down through a textile co-op. Washed, pressed, and packed as a set of three.

products.title: Walnut Floating Shelf
products.description: A minimal floating shelf milled from solid walnut — clean, gallery-like display for ceramics and books.
products.story: A quiet ledge for the objects you live with every day.
products.whyMade: We needed a shelf that disappeared into the wall so ceramics and books could speak. Made for small Indian apartments where every centimetre of display matters.
products.howMade: Milled from solid walnut, hand-sanded, and finished with hardwax oil that deepens the grain over time. Hidden steel brackets keep the line clean.

products.title: Ceramic Pour-Over Set
products.description: A hand-thrown pour-over dripper with matching mug — ritual coffee, elevated.
products.story: For the morning ritual that starts before the city wakes.
products.whyMade: Filter coffee and pour-over deserve vessels that make the pause feel intentional. This set was refined for balanced flow and easy cleaning after years of daily use.
products.howMade: Hand-thrown porcelain dripper and mug, glazed in a satin matte finish, and kiln-fired for everyday strength. The spout angle was adjusted across many studio mornings.

products.title: Woven Rattan Mirror
products.description: A circular mirror framed in handwoven rattan — organic texture for entryways and dressing nooks.
products.story: Woven to catch first light in the hallway — a soft welcome home.
products.whyMade: Entryways often get forgotten. This mirror was made to greet you with warmth and texture — a handmade pause before the day begins or ends.
products.howMade: Each rattan frame takes a full day of careful weaving around tempered glass. Edges are bound by hand so the circle stays true and soft to the touch.

products.title: Cedarwood Diffuser Candle
products.description: A soy-blend candle with notes of cedarwood, amber, and soft musk in reusable amber glass.
products.story: Blended for evenings when you want the room to exhale.
products.whyMade: We wanted a scent that felt like open windows after rain — woody, calm, never overpowering. Made for Indian living rooms where fragrance should linger gently.
products.howMade: Blended by hand in small batches with soy wax and essential oils. Poured into reusable amber glass; the wooden lid doubles as a coaster when the candle is lit.
products.materials: Soy wax blend, essential oils, amber glass

products.title: Braided Plant Hanger
products.description: A sculptural plant hanger braided from soft cotton rope — bring greenery into vertical space.
products.story: Braided so greenery can climb where floors cannot.
products.whyMade: Vertical space is often unused in compact homes. This hanger was made so plants — and the calm they bring — can live at eye level without cluttering the floor.
products.howMade: Braided by hand from organic cotton rope in small studio batches. Knots are tensioned for strength, then trimmed and steam-set so the shape holds.
